This is from Bob Uhl’s recipe for [http://latakia.dyndns.org/~ruhl/recipes/azteca Azteca] found on his [http://latakia.dyndns.org/~ruhl/recipes/bachelor bachelor recipes site]. It is inspired—in the loosest sense; it is ''not at all historical''—by the diet of the Aztecs, whence comes the name. It’s quite tasty and filling.

== Ingredients ==

* 1 can (~2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]]) [[Cookbook:Corn|corn]]
* 1 can (~2 cups) [[cookbook:Kidney Bean|kidney beans]]
* 1 can (~2 cups) [[cookbook:Black Bean|black beans]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], finely [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
* 4 cloves [[cookbook:garlic|garlic]], finely minced
* 6 dried pequin [[cookbook:Chile Pepper|chiles]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* [[cookbook:Mustard Seed|Mustard seed]], [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]], and freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]], to taste

== Procedure ==

# Mix ingredients in pot.
# Add three cans of water.
# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] until done.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* For a historically accurate version, substitute pinto beans for kidney beans, use Mexican green onions, omit garlic and mustard seed, and substitute powdered chili pepper for black pepper.
